text_block_list.text:
After our outing with Yamanin Zephyr.
While accompanying her on a shopping trip to an organic store—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, what a coincidence~! Are you out shopping too, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. To buy some face wash.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean that's the secret
to your super baby-smooth egg skin, Zeph-chi?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Please, Zephyr-tchi!
Teach us your ultimate skincare routine!!

According to Mejiro Palmer and the others,
it seems staying up late ended up breaking out their skin...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr, your skin is super pretty!
It's crazy smooth and so supple!
I've been wondering what kind of skincare you use!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I regularly use this face wash.
It's an organic product made by the company my mother works for—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, organic!!
You really know what's trending, huh☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say I'm a weathervane, but...
...I did grow up alongside nature, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—When I was young, I was rather sickly,
and spent my days in a lush, green land
filled with fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Eating food nurtured by the winds of bounty,
frolicking with plants and animals... For a long time,
I have been blessed by the gifts of nature.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I see! So eating organic food is what made me so healthy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Organic is god-tier!
You just gotta respect it, right?! For that glowing skin!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Are you interested in organic food?
In that case――
Guided by Yamanin Zephyr, we arrived at the academy's vegetable field.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
All the vegetables here are grown without chemical fertilizers,
nurtured purely by favorable breezes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Isn't that the whole "darkest under the lighthouse" thing?! To think organic was right under our noses all along!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The vegetables gathered beside the field are bruised
ones we can't use in the cafeteria, so anyone can take
some if they'd like. Please, take some, you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes! Don't mind if I do~♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I will...
spend some time bonding with the soil for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Can I join in too?
Kinda feels like it'd be good for my skin!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I think I'm curious about how
Zephyr connects with nature, too♪"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give it a try too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My... How novel.
Let us do it together, then.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Weeds, begone! ...Wait, bwahaha!☆
There's way too many earthworms here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Mr. Wriggles. Look how big
you've gotten... That's proof the soil is good.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh~, really?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Try placing your hands into the soil.
It is warm and soft—truly good soil, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Whoa! Seriously!
The soil's so warm. Cozy, cozy~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Grow big and strong, everyone!
Palmer-san's got high hopes for ya~

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, with such a pleasant and gentle tone of voice...
So you knew the secret to growing delicious vegetables all along, Palmer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, looking at vegetables, I dunno... It felt like they're trying so hard to live, so I kind of wanted to cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they grow better the more gentle breeze they receive.
Please feel free to call on me anytime.
choice_data_list: Alright... Grow big and strong! Turn out delicious!

text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, dusk had fallen.
It seems I was so engrossed in working the field...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The evening breeze will be dying down soon.
Let's head back now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... I was just wondering why you came along
with me, Trainer. Were you interested in the fields?
choice_data_list: Because you looked like you were having fun!
Because I wanted to get to know you better
Because I wanted to get to know you better

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... I was just wondering why you came along
with me, Trainer. Were you interested in the fields?
choice_data_list: Because you looked like you were having fun!
Because I wanted to get to know you better
Because I wanted to get to know you better

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see... It turned into a whirlwind, did it?
Did you enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I got dirt under my nails!
It won't come out at all! Lol, iconic~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, an earthworm again!?
...Wait, why is it starting to look kind of cute!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone was able to catch
a favorable breeze of their own. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...You were trying to find a new breeze through your communion with nature, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, looks like it didn't get through to them☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the road ahead will be rough, but I'm rooting for you.
Do your best, Trainer!

After that awkward conversation,
it made me truly want to get to know
Yamanin Zephyr much better.
